long_biography.plain_text:
Borançılı trained as an architect at Istanbul Technical University and spent his early career in design, contracting and construction. He then helped establish GittiGidiyor, combining fixed-price listings with escrow to localise the online-marketplace model for Turkey. The company attracted eBay as a minority investor before the American group acquired nearly all outstanding shares.

Borançılı co-founded local portal Istanbul.net, video platform UzmanTV, price-comparison service Cimri and payments business iPara. He also became an early investor in several Turkish startups. At Getir, he joined the founding team as both an investor and operator, bringing marketplace experience to a mobile delivery business. With several longtime partners, he also established Omurga Yapı as a separate property-development venture.

The unpublished transaction terms and personal proceeds are not estimated.
